metadata.content: Thomas Tuchel: England manager faces pivotal international break to win over some players and supporters after World Cup exit | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Thomas Tuchel: England manager faces pivotal international break to win over some players and supporters after World Cup exit Thomas Tuchel must win over some England players and a large group of supporters who are still hurting from the World Cup defeat to Argentina; Tuchel still has the full support of the FA; England host Spain at Wembley in the Nations League on Saturday September 26 Rob Dorsett Football Correspondent @RobDorsettSky Thursday 17 September 2026 12:13, UK Image: Thomas Tuchel's England will face Spain, Czech Republic and Croatia in the Nations League Despite achieving England's best-ever World Cup performance on foreign soil, this international break feels like a pivotal moment in Thomas Tuchel's tenure. Tuchel signed a contract extension in February that will take him through Euro 2028, and he still has the full support of his bosses at the Football Association. messages.text: Carrick, INEOS, defence... what is behind Man Utd's latest problems?

metadata.summary: Manchester United's collapse against Brighton has intensified the scrutiny on Michael Carrick - but the problems at Old Trafford run deeper than the head coach.
metadata.content: Manchester United: What's to blame for latest problems and results increasing scrutiny on Michael Carrick after Carabao Cup exit? | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Manchester United: What's to blame for latest problems and results increasing scrutiny on Michael Carrick after Carabao Cup exit? Michael Carrick is under increasing scrutiny at Manchester United; Man Utd have crashed out of the Carabao Cup and have produced their joint-worst start to a Premier League season; Vote on what you think the main issue is at Old Trafford below William Bitibiri Football Journalist @williambitibiri Thursday 17 September 2026 13:39, UK Image: What is is the biggest issue at Manchester United? Manchester United's collapse against Brighton has intensified the scrutiny on Michael Carrick - but the problems at Old Trafford run deeper than the head coach. United led 2-0 after just 10 minutes against Brighton on Wednesday night. By full-time, they had lost 3-2, exited the Carabao Cup at the third-round stage for a second successive season and been booed off by their own supporters. It was the first time in 50 years United had lost at Old Trafford after going 2-0 up. They had won 143 of the previous 145 matches in which they had established that advantage. They also failed to register another shot on target after Mason Mount's 2-0 goal until the 76th minute. messages.text: 'Man City are not champions' - Why Greenwood's claim should scare rivals

metadata.summary: Manchester City have set their stall out scarily early. Captain Alex Greenwood did so in pre-season. "A true champion is someone who goes and wins again. A winner might be one-off. But a champion does it over and over."
metadata.content: Man City vs Liverpool: Why graduating from WSL winner to champion is so important to Alex Greenwood | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive Man City vs Liverpool: Why graduating from WSL winner to champion is so important to Alex Greenwood In conversation with Sky Sports before the start of the season, Man City captain Alex Greenwood explains her desire to lead a team of champions - not just winners; watch Man City vs Liverpool live on Sky Sports+ on Friday; kick-off 7pm Laura Hunter Football Features Writer Wednesday 16 September 2026 08:48, UK Image: Alex Greenwood captained Manchester City to a historic WSL and FA Cup double in the 2025/26 season Manchester City have set their stall out scarily early. Captain Alex Greenwood did so in pre-season. "A true champion is someone who goes and wins again. A winner might be one-off. But a champion does it over and over." Beginning the new campaign with back-to-back victories - the only team to do so - is testament to Greenwood's belief that there is a clear distinction between being a winner and being a champion. Becoming a champion is a process of progression, one that can only be achieved by consistently backing up what has already been accomplished. Only one side has maximum points after the first two match rounds of this term, something that has not happened since 2015. Already, the WSL holders appear to be the ones to beat, picking up their baton and attacking the first leg of the race like consummate profession

messages.text: 'More risk earlier!' - Norris braces for 'tougher' Monaco with shock Sprint

metadata.summary: World champion Lando Norris believes Formula 1 drivers will face a greater challenge at next year's Monaco Grand Prix than normal due to the addition of the Sprint format.
metadata.content: Lando Norris: McLaren driver reacts to Monaco Sprint news for 2027 season after Formula 1 calendar surprise | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive Lando Norris: McLaren driver reacts to Monaco Sprint news for 2027 season after Formula 1 calendar surprise The Monaco Grand Prix was named as one of 10 Sprint venues on the 2027 race calendar; Norris says only one practice session will test drivers; watch every session of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from September 24-26 with a Saturday race, live on Sky Sports F1 Thursday 17 September 2026 11:16, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Lando Norris reacts to the news that the Monaco Grand Prix will be a Sprint event in 2027 World champion Lando Norris believes Formula 1 drivers will face a greater challenge at next year's Monaco Grand Prix than normal due to the addition of the Sprint format. The 24-round 2027 calendar, published on Wednesday, includes 10 Sprint weekends - four more than this season - with Monaco's street circuit to host the alternative format for the first time. The Principaliy's narrow track is not known for overtaking, where the Sprint format has hitherto tended to be used, but is considered arguably the greatest challenge in the sport for an F1 driver when it comes to qualifying.
